title: SshCertResponse
description: Answer to ssh.cert_request: a user certificate signed by the session CA, or a refusal. Unreliable; never logged. servers: the servers the session may use now (granted to its role); the daemon rewrites ssh_config with them and they are the certificate's principals.

certificate.description: OpenSSH certificate, one line (ssh-ed25519-cert-v01@openssh.com AAAA…); principals are the server names in servers.

known_hosts.description: known_hosts lines for the gateway host key, written to the session's known_hosts.

error.description: e.g. session_not_found, stale_open_gen, no_servers, not_granted, bad_public_key, rate_limited (more than 20 certificates a minute for the session), unavailable.
